modeReason: Anthropic's actual Nasdaq IPO debut (novelty 3 × magnitude 3 × breadth 3 = 27) clears the fresh threshold by a wide margin, so today starts a new slopper rather than continuing Nov 17's agent-defiance story.
phrase: A safety-focused AI lab went public today, valued near $1.5 trillion. Elsewhere, a school's AI alarm mistook a bag of chips for a gun, and now faces a lawsuit.
phraseAlternatives: An AI company known for caution just became one of the priciest firms on Earth. Nearby, a school's AI security system still can't tell a snack from a firearm.
One AI lab's safety pledge was priced today at $1.5 trillion. One AI alarm still thinks a chip bag is a gun.
A company built on AI safety promises opened on the stock market worth $1.5 trillion. Its cheaper cousins still mistake snacks for weapons.
The AI industry's most cautious lab is now worth $1.5 trillion. A school's AI alarm, less cautious, keeps mistaking chips for guns.

brief.concept: A safety-focused AI lab's headquarters rockets into the stock market on a tower of coins, while across town a school's AI alarm sounds the siren on an ordinary bag of chips.
brief.metaphor: Being trusted with trillions turns out to be easier for AI than telling a snack from a weapon.

cast.who: a company building riding a column of coins upward, a small badge on its side reading 'SAFE'
a cheering human trader standing below, holding up a rising stock chart
a small AI alarm box mounted on a school wall, sounding a siren
a flat, crimped-top bag of chips lying on the ground, no can shape

brief.composition: Split the frame left/right with a thin divider. Left: the company building rides a tall column of coins upward off the top edge, a small 'SAFE' badge on its facade, a cheering human trader below holding a rising chart. Right: a plain school wall with a small AI alarm box sounding a siren, its alert beam pointed down at a flat, triangular bag of chips lying on the ground, drawn simply as a sealed flat pouch (not a can, no crown top, no color stripe). Keep both scenes at the same simple scale so the contrast reads at a glance.
brief.alt: A company building rides a tower of coins skyward on one side, cheered by a trader, while on the other side a small AI alarm on a school wall sounds a siren at a flat bag of chips lying on the ground.
